description: Arc 17 §17.3.7 — evict entries from the dynamic-lexicon resolver's in-memory cache. One of `nsid` or `all` must be supplied (mutually exclusive). On-disk rows are NOT touched; they rehydrate on next fetch or expire via TTL. Auth: AdminAll scope.

nsid.description: Evict a specific entry. No-op if not cached.

all.description: Evict every in-memory entry. Only `true` is meaningful; `false` is the absent state. Mutually exclusive with `nsid`.

evicted.description: Count of in-memory entries actually removed.
